thread:
mike: Heads-up: staging job started failing with 'couldn't find token at /var/run/secrets/...' after recent TF changes. Anyone seen this?

serena: Hmm thanks. Which job and which cluster? Did we rotate sa creds?

mike: batch-stager job in staging. Not rotated. The path in logs is /var/run/secrets/tokens/sa-token rather than /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token — our init container expects the latter.

raj: That's the projected SA token feature (BoundServiceAccountTokenVolume). kubelet started emitting tokens under /var/run/secrets/tokens when using projected tokens. We enabled TF module to use projected token in pod volumes? show pod spec?

mike: snippet:
```yaml
spec:
  containers:
  - name: uploader
    volumeMounts:
    - name: sa-token
      mountPath: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
  volumes:
  - name: sa-token
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          path: sa-token
          audience: "sts.amazonaws.com"
          expirationSeconds: 3600
```

serena: If you're mounting projected token with path sa-token then inside mount it appears under /var/run/secrets/tokens/sa-token, not under serviceaccount token path. Either change mountPath to mountTokens path or update init container to read /var/run/secrets/tokens/sa-token. Also check automountServiceAccountToken: false/true.

mike: Oh — TF module sets automountServiceAccountToken=false by default. Our init container expects default token mount (legacy). Should we flip automount or update init container?

raj: Prefer update init container to use projected path. It's future-proof and avoids duplicating token mount. Quick fix: change init container env to TOKEN_PATH=/var/run/secrets/tokens/sa-token. Or set serviceAccountToken.path to kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token — but I think kube doesn't allow that for projected.

elaine: @mike +1 to updating init container. Also add a small note in helm values to document token path. And update terraform module docs. I can add a one-liner PR for the init image.

mike: I'll push PR updating init container env and add note. pinging @infra-bot for deploy validation.

infra-bot: deploy-check: plan ok for staging, no API diff that touches IAM. :white_check_mark:

serena: Thanks. After PR can we run quick canary? Maybe set replica to 1 in staging.

mike: Will do. ETA ~30m. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
